headline: Nigeria Reps Reaffirm NMDPRA Authority Over Gas Distribution Licences
summary: Nigeria's House of Representatives reaffirmed the statutory authority of the Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority to grant gas distribution licences, dismissing a petition against licences issued to NIPCO Plc.
why: Regulatory clarity in the midstream and downstream energy sector ensures operational stability for licensed petroleum and gas distributors.

impacts.name: NIPCO Plc
impacts.why: House of Representatives dismissed petition challenging gas distribution licences issued to NIPCO.
